description: Plan breakfast, lunch and dinner for 7 days; saves automatically and prints nicely.

faqs.a: Click any cell and type a meal. Every edit saves automatically to this browser.
faqs.q: How do I fill in the plan?

faqs.a: The grid covers Monday–Sunday with breakfast, lunch and dinner rows. Change the week label if you want.
faqs.q: What days and meals does it cover?

faqs.a: Click Print / Save PDF and use your browser's print dialog. The plan prints as a clean table.
Yes — everything is stored in localStorage on this device.

howto: Click any cell and type the meal for that day.
The plan saves automatically as you type.
Optionally rename the week label at the top.
Click Print / Save PDF to print or download it.
title: Weekly Meal Planner
